evidence: Premise refuted on the named platform: macOS ships sort 2.3-Apple whose man page documents the -z option and `printf 'b\0a\0a\0' | /usr/bin/sort -zu` returns the deduplicated NUL records (observed on macOS 26.4.1); the census test leg 12 runs that exact path on this host and passes; the CI runner is GNU userland. Non-macOS BSDs are outside the declared baseline (macOS bash 3.2 and GNU userland). No change.
